If your app's main feature is random or anonymous chat with strangers:
- Block minors using Play Console tools.
- Don't aim it at children in Google's Families program.
- Publish your standards against child sexual abuse and exploitation.
- Let people report abuse inside the app.
- Remove child sexual abuse material.
- Name a contact for child safety.

APPLE-SOCIAL-MEDIA-DECLARATION-GATE.title: Declare if your app has social features
APPLE-SOCIAL-MEDIA-DECLARATION-GATE.summary:
From September 2026, say if your app or game has social media features. Apple hasn't named the exact day.
You need to answer before you can:
- Submit a new version or update.
- Notarize for other app marketplaces.
If you say yes:
- Your app is rated 13+ at least.
- It counts as Social Media for screen time limits.
- Under-13 users need Apple's age range tool (Declared Age Range API).

EU-DMA-UNIFIED-TERMS-2026.title: New Apple fees and payment choices
EU-DMA-UNIFIED-TERMS-2026.summary:
From 1 October 2026:
- Apps outside the App Store pay 5 percent on digital sales.
- This replaces the per-install fee.
- Two fees end: Initial Acquisition and Store Services.
- Apps can offer other payment options beside Apple's.
- More apps qualify for other stores or the web, in seven ways.
You must accept the new terms part (Attachment 14).

APPLE-ADPLA-ATTACHMENT-12-BRAZIL.title: Accept Apple's new terms for Brazil
APPLE-ADPLA-ATTACHMENT-12-BRAZIL.summary:
All Apple developers had to accept Apple's updated agreement by 6 July 2026. If you haven't, you can't submit anything new.
From iOS 26.5, in Brazil you can:
- Offer your app in other app stores.
- Run your own app store.
- Take payments for digital items outside Apple's in-app purchase.

APPLE-REGION-AGE-RATINGS-AU-VN-2026.title: Age rating changes in Australia and Vietnam
APPLE-REGION-AGE-RATINGS-AU-VN-2026.summary:
From 18 June 2026:
- Australia no longer has a 15+ rating.
- Apps rated 15+ there move to 16+.
- Apps in Vietnam need a rating just for Vietnam.
- That rating must follow Vietnam's local rules.
Check your age rating for each country in App Store Connect.

GOOGLE-PLAY-BILLING-V8-EXISTING-2027.title: Update your Play billing add-on code
GOOGLE-PLAY-BILLING-V8-EXISTING-2027.summary:
All published apps need newer Play billing add-on code:
- Version 8 by 31 August 2027, or 1 November 2027 if extended.
- Version 9 by 31 August 2028, or 1 November 2028 if extended.
New submissions needed version 8 by 31 August 2026. That could be extended to 1 November 2026. Older published versions can still take payments until their deadline.

US-ADA-TITLE-II-WCAG-2027.title: Make government apps meet accessibility rules
US-ADA-TITLE-II-WCAG-2027.summary:
From 26 April 2027, some government apps must meet WCAG 2.1 Level AA:
- Apps from state or local governments.
- Only those serving 50,000 or more people.
- It reaches you if you build or license the app to them.
- The old date of 24 April 2026 was pushed back.

US-ADA-TITLE-II-WCAG-2028.title: Accessible apps for smaller governments and districts
US-ADA-TITLE-II-WCAG-2028.summary: The same rule covers governments serving under 50,000 people. It also covers every special district government. Their apps must meet the WCAG 2.1 Level AA standard by 26 April 2028.

US-HHS-504-WCAG-2027.title: Accessible apps for US health funding recipients
US-HHS-504-WCAG-2027.summary:
If your app comes from a group funded by the US health department (HHS):
- The rule applies if they have 15 or more employees.
- It covers apps they offer directly or through a contract or license.
- The app must meet the WCAG 2.1 Level AA accessibility standard.
- The deadline is now 11 May 2027, not 11 May 2026.

US-HHS-504-WCAG-2028.title: Small groups get more accessibility time
US-HHS-504-WCAG-2028.summary: It covers groups with fewer than 15 employees that get HHS funding. Your app must meet the WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility standard. The deadline moved from 10 May 2027 to 10 May 2028.

US-FTC-COPPA-AGE-VERIFICATION-POLICY.title: Use age data only to check ages
US-FTC-COPPA-AGE-VERIFICATION-POLICY.summary:
Apps not made only for kids may collect data to check ages. The FTC won't punish this only if you:
- Use the data only to work out ages.
- Keep it for as short a time as you can.
- Check any outside companies that get it.
- Tell parents and children about it.
- Keep it secure.
This holds until final child privacy rule changes come out or it's withdrawn.

UK-DUAA-COMPLAINTS-PROCESS-2026.title: Handle privacy complaints from users
UK-DUAA-COMPLAINTS-PROCESS-2026.summary:
Set up a way for people to complain about their data:
- Confirm you got a complaint within 30 days.
- Then reply without needless delay.

UK-ICO-STORAGE-ACCESS-GUIDANCE-2026.title: Recheck all tracking, not just cookies
UK-ICO-STORAGE-ACCESS-GUIDANCE-2026.summary:
Recheck every way your app tracks people, not only cookies:
- Every add-on code.
- Every tracking pixel.
- Every call that fingerprints a device.
Check each one against the new ICO guidance. Consent breaches now face much bigger fines. The top fine is 17.5 million pounds or 4 percent of turnover.

UK-DMCCA-SUBSCRIPTIONS-2027.title: New rules for subscriptions that renew themselves
UK-DMCCA-SUBSCRIPTIONS-2027.summary:
Subscription apps that renew for UK users need:
- Clear details before they buy.
- Renewal reminders.
- Two cooling-off periods.
- An easy way to cancel.
- The new refund rules.
The UK said on 9 August 2026 it starts January 2027, not spring. A draft rule names 1 January 2027. It wasn't final by 14 November 2026, so it may change.

UK-OSA-APP-STORES-REPORT-2027.title: App stores may face online safety rules
UK-OSA-APP-STORES-REPORT-2027.summary: Ofcom will publish a report on children's use of app stores by January 2027. The government will use it to decide if app stores come under the law. You have no direct duty yet, but keep watching.

UK-UNDER16-SOCIAL-MEDIA-2027.title: Block under 16s from social apps
UK-UNDER16-SOCIAL-MEDIA-2027.summary:
The rules are due by the end of 2026. They start in spring 2027, tracked as 1 March 2027. Social apps where users reach each other must block anyone under 16. AI romance chatbots must block anyone under 18. For 16 and 17 year olds, social apps must:
- Turn off livestreaming by default.
- Turn off contact from strangers by default.
- Turn off autoplay by default.
- Turn off personalised feeds by default.
- Stop notifications from midnight to 6am.

EU-AI-ACT-MARKING-RETROFIT-2026.title: Add AI labels and ban abuse imagery
EU-AI-ACT-MARKING-RETROFIT-2026.summary:
This covers AI that makes audio, images, video or text.
If it was on the market before 2 August 2026, mark its output.
The mark must show it's AI-made in a form computers can read.
Stop any AI system that is meant to make, or could foreseeably make:
- Intimate images of people without their consent.
- Child sexual abuse material.

EU-PRODUCT-LIABILITY-SOFTWARE-2026.title: Apps and updates count as products
EU-PRODUCT-LIABILITY-SOFTWARE-2026.summary: From 9 December 2026, standalone software and app updates count as products. You can be held responsible for harm they cause, even without fault. This covers anything released or put into use on or after that date.

EU-DATA-ACT-SWITCHING-2027.title: Let customers switch away for free
EU-DATA-ACT-SWITCHING-2027.summary:
If you provide data processing services:
- Charge nothing when a customer switches away.
- Check open-ended or long contracts signed on or before 12 September 2025.
- They must meet the unfair terms rules by 12 September 2027.

EU-EIDAS-WALLET-ACCEPTANCE-2027.title: Accept the EU ID wallet at login
EU-EIDAS-WALLET-ACCEPTANCE-2027.summary:
If your private business isn't micro or small and uses strong login checks:
- This covers banking, finance, health or telecom.
- It also covers transport, energy, education or digital infrastructure.
- Accept the EU Digital Identity Wallet when a user asks.
- Starts 24 December 2027 by calculation, 36 months after EU detailed rules.

EU-CSAM-EPRIVACY-DEROGATION-EXPIRY-2028.title: Voluntary scans for child abuse images end
EU-CSAM-EPRIVACY-DEROGATION-EXPIRY-2028.summary:
If your messaging app chooses to scan for child sexual abuse material:
- This covers chat apps not tied to phone numbers.
- That scanning is lawful only until 3 April 2028.
- After that, you need backing from the permanent law (CSA Regulation).
- Without it, you must stop scanning.

KR-PIPA-AMENDMENT-2026.title: Make your CEO answer for privacy
KR-PIPA-AMENDMENT-2026.summary:
This law changes who answers for privacy at your company.
- Name your CEO and representative as finally responsible.
- If you're big enough, appoint a chief privacy officer.
- Your board must approve that officer.
- Expect extra fines meant to punish.
- Expect to report data breaches in more cases.

KR-PIPA-MANDATORY-CERTIFICATION-2027.title: Get a Korean privacy certificate
KR-PIPA-MANDATORY-CERTIFICATION-2027.summary: From 1 July 2027, some businesses in Korea need a privacy certificate. It comes from Korea's Personal Information Protection Commission. A decree will set who, by revenue and amount of personal data. Not getting it can bring a fine. The decree wasn't out on 14 November 2026. Check if you're covered once it is.

CN-AI-COMPANION-MINORS-2026.title: Protect minors in AI companion apps
CN-AI-COMPANION-MINORS-2026.summary:
If you offer a chat, companion or roleplay app in China:
- Spot users who are minors.
- Switch them to minors mode automatically.
- Get a guardian's OK for users under 14.
- Never offer minors a virtual companion or virtual family member.

SG-OSRAA-COMMENCEMENT-2026.title: Act on online safety commission notices
SG-OSRAA-COMMENCEMENT-2026.summary: If your app is a platform, act when the Online Safety Commission notifies you. For now this covers five priority types of harm. More types will be added over time, with no date set yet.

IN-DPDPA-CONSENT-MANAGERS-2026.title: Get ready to work with consent managers
IN-DPDPA-CONSENT-MANAGERS-2026.summary:
Registered consent managers start one year after the rules came out.
- The rules were published on 13 November 2025.
- Be ready to work with a registered consent manager.
- Do it before the next stage, on 13 May 2027.
- That stage starts 18 months after publication.

JP-APPI-AMENDMENT-2028.title: Rework consent and children's data handling
JP-APPI-AMENDMENT-2028.summary:
If your app handles personal data, rework:
- How you get consent.
- How you handle children's data.
- How you handle body data (biometric data).
For users under 16, deal with their parent or guardian. This covers consent, notices and requests to stop using data. The law starts within two years of 17 July 2026. The government sets the exact day. Penalty rules start 17 January 2027. Money penalties need a government order within those two years.

AU-ADS-CODE-AGE-ASSURANCE-2026.title: Check ages before adult app downloads
AU-ADS-CODE-AGE-ASSURANCE-2026.summary:
App stores must do this six months after the rules started:
- Check ages before anyone downloads or buys an adult app.
- Limit who can get adult apps.
- Hand in a first risk check that same day.
- The time allowed to work towards the rules also ends then.
This came from an archived copy of eSafety pages updated 19 May 2026. Check the live register.

AU-PRIVACY-ADM-DISCLOSURE-2026.title: Explain automated decisions in your privacy policy
AU-PRIVACY-ADM-DISCLOSURE-2026.summary:
If software decides things that seriously affect people's rights or interests:
- From 10 December 2026, say so in your privacy policy.
- List the kinds of personal information it uses.
- List the decisions it makes.

AU-CHILDRENS-ONLINE-PRIVACY-CODE-2026.title: Children's privacy rules for online services
AU-CHILDRENS-ONLINE-PRIVACY-CODE-2026.summary:
A children's privacy code must be finalised and registered by 10 December 2026.
Its binding rules will cover:
- Social media.
- Services that let users communicate, like chat or online games.
- Other internet services named under the law.

BR-DECRETO-12880-AGE-SIGNALS-2026.title: Stores must give and check age signals
BR-DECRETO-12880-AGE-SIGNALS-2026.summary:
App stores and operating systems must:
- Give apps a free age signal.
- Ask age when someone makes an account.
- Check it with a method the regulator (ANPD) approves.
- Let people challenge the age result.
- Ask a parent or guardian for permission.
- Show the age rating before download.
Stores must also block gambling and lottery apps. They must block any app with no way to check age.

BR-ANPD-ECA-ENFORCEMENT-2027.title: Age check rules enforced from January 2027
BR-ANPD-ECA-ENFORCEMENT-2027.summary: Brazil's data agency will publish age check guidance and rules from August 2026. Apps then have until November 2026 to adapt. Active enforcement of age check duties starts January 2027.

US-TAKE-IT-DOWN-ACT-2026.title: Remove shared intimate images within 48 hours
US-TAKE-IT-DOWN-ACT-2026.summary:
If your platform is covered, act on intimate images shared without consent:
- Offer a clear, easy to find way to report them.
- Remove reported images within 48 hours.
- Remove known identical copies in that time too.
The US trade regulator (FTC) began enforcing this on 19 May 2026.

US-CA-AB1043-AGE-SIGNAL-2027.title: Use the age signal from stores
US-CA-AB1043-AGE-SIGNAL-2027.summary:
From 1 January 2027, operating systems and app stores ask age during setup.
They share an age range signal through code (API).
Your app must ask for that signal and use it.

US-CA-SB976-ADDICTIVE-FEEDS-2027.title: Treat users as minors for addictive feeds
US-CA-SB976-ADDICTIVE-FEEDS-2027.summary:
From 1 January 2027, treat every user as a minor by default.
This applies unless age checks reasonably show they are adults.
Do this before you:
- Show an addictive feed.
- Send notifications from midnight to 6am.
- Send notifications during school hours.
The state attorney general's age check rules are due the same day.

US-CA-AB56-WARNING-LABEL-2027.title: Show the Surgeon General's warning label
US-CA-AB56-WARNING-LABEL-2027.summary:
Covered social media apps must show the Surgeon General's black box warning. Show it:
- The first time someone opens the app each day.
- Again after 3 hours of total use.
- Then every hour after that.
This starts 1 January 2027.

US-CA-CPPA-ADMT-2027.title: Rules for automated decisions about people
US-CA-CPPA-ADMT-2027.summary:
If automated tools make major decisions about people, by 1 January 2027:
- Tell people about it.
- Let them opt out.
- Answer their requests for access.
Assess risks of data use from before 2026 by 31 December 2027. Submit those assessments by 1 April 2028. Businesses with revenue over 100 million dollars certify security audits from 1 April 2028.

US-CA-SB243-COMPANION-CHATBOT-2027.title: Yearly crisis report for companion chatbots
US-CA-SB243-COMPANION-CHATBOT-2027.summary:
From 1 July 2027, companion chatbot apps must report each year:
- Send it to the Office of Suicide Prevention.
- Cover your referrals of users to crisis services.
- Describe your crisis plans.
- Keep doing the notice and minor safety duties already in force.

US-NY-SAFE-FOR-KIDS-2027.title: Limit addictive feeds for minors
US-NY-SAFE-FOR-KIDS-2027.summary:
From 25 January 2027, limit these for minors without proven parental consent:
- Addictive feeds
- Notifications between midnight and 6am
Use a certified age check to find out who is a minor.

US-VT-AADC-2027.title: Safer default settings for children
US-VT-AADC-2027.summary:
From 1 January 2027, if children use your app:
- Set the most private settings by default.
- Collect only the data you need.
- Don't send push notifications late at night.
- Follow the Attorney General's rules on checking age.
Comments on those rules were due 2 October 2026.

US-WA-HB2225-COMPANION-CHATBOT-2027.title: Rules for AI companion chatbots
US-WA-HB2225-COMPANION-CHATBOT-2027.summary:
From 1 January 2027, if your app has an AI companion chatbot:
- Show users a notice about the chatbot.
- Protect users under 18.
- Show under 18s the notice every hour while they keep chatting.

US-CO-SB26-051-AGE-SIGNAL-2028.title: Ask the device for the user's age
US-CO-SB26-051-AGE-SIGNAL-2028.summary:
Companies that make device systems must ask age at account setup. They must also share a live age signal with apps (API). Your app must ask for this signal at launch or account creation.
This starts 1 July 2028. Devices already in use must be covered by 1 January 2029.

US-OK-SB546-PRIVACY-2027.title: Honour new privacy rights for users
US-OK-SB546-PRIVACY-2027.summary:
From 1 January 2027, let people:
- See the data you hold on them.
- Fix it.
- Delete it.
- Take a copy with them.
- Opt out of having it sold.
- Opt out of targeted ads and profiling.

APPLE-MULTISEAT-VOLUME-PURCHASING.title: Choose who can buy group subscription seats
APPLE-MULTISEAT-VOLUME-PURCHASING.summary:
Since 16 September 2026, your subscriptions allow buying many seats by default.
Volume buying through Apple Business and Apple School Manager starts 22 October 2026. Group buying starts this winter.
Before 22 October 2026, for each auto-renewing subscription:
- Decide if groups and organizations may buy seats.
- Turn it off or limit it where it breaks pricing or access.
- Limits can cover App Store, Apple Business, Apple School Manager.

APPLE-AGE-RATING-LOCATION-DATING-2027.title: Declare location sharing and dating features
APPLE-AGE-RATING-LOCATION-DATING-2027.summary:
From 16 November 2026, the age rating questions ask if your app has:
- Shared Location: sharing real-world location with others.
- Dating and Relationships: features for dating or relationships between real people.
Every app must answer both by 12 January 2027. Updates or answer changes before then must include them. Dating and Relationships makes your rating 18+ at minimum.

APPLE-DEVELOPER-ID-SUBCA-EXPIRY-2027.title: Replace your Mac signing certificate
APPLE-DEVELOPER-ID-SUBCA-EXPIRY-2027.summary:
The older system Apple uses to issue Developer ID certificates expires 1 February 2027. Certificates it issued stop working that day.
If you share Mac apps outside the Mac App Store, do this before then:
- Make a new Developer ID certificate from the G2 authority.
- Re-sign every installer package you share outside the store.

GOOGLE-JAPAN-PAYMENTS-AUTHORIZATION-2026.title: Fill in a payments form for Japan
GOOGLE-JAPAN-PAYMENTS-AUTHORIZATION-2026.summary: Do you sell into or out of Japan? Then fill in the payments approval form in Play Console. Do it by 1 December 2026. If you don't, Google holds all your payments worldwide.

GOOGLE-SUBSCRIPTION-ELIGIBILITY-DISCOUNT.title: Explain who qualifies for discounted subscriptions
GOOGLE-SUBSCRIPTION-ELIGIBILITY-DISCOUNT.summary:
Some subscriptions stay discounted only for certain people, like student plans. For these, clearly show:
- Who qualifies.
- How you check that they qualify.
- The price and benefits once they stop qualifying.

GOOGLE-APPFUNCTIONS-POLICY-2027.title: Keep AI agent actions honest and safe
GOOGLE-APPFUNCTIONS-POLICY-2027.summary:
If your app lets AI agents use its actions (AppFunctions):
- Follow every Google Play rule.
- Don't trick or steer AI agents.
- Don't get around security protections.
- Don't interfere with other apps.

GOOGLE-LOCAL-NETWORK-MANAGE-CONTACTS-202.title: Limits on local network and managing contacts
GOOGLE-LOCAL-NETWORK-MANAGE-CONTACTS-202.summary:
Two permissions are now limited to your app's main features.
- Local Network: only if device pickers can't do the job.
- Targeting Android 17 (API 37) or higher? Declare it in Play Console.
- Manage Contacts: only if system pickers fall short.
- Manage Contacts also needs a declaration.
- Every other app must use narrow, built-in system requests.

CN-CAC-MINOR-PLATFORM-FILING-2026.title: Large platforms used by minors must register
CN-CAC-MINOR-PLATFORM-FILING-2026.summary:
Your platform must file if any apply:
- 10 million or more registered minor users.
- 1 million or more monthly active minor users.
- A big impact on minors.
- Aimed at minors: 10 million registered and 1 million monthly active users.
Send papers and a self-check report to your provincial internet office.
File within 20 working days of the 19 October 2026 notice.
That's about 16 November 2026, by our count.
If you qualify but don't file, you'll be told to.

ID-PP-TUNAS-SELF-ASSESSMENT-2026.title: Child safety self-check for every feature
ID-PP-TUNAS-SELF-ASSESSMENT-2026.summary:
Every online service operator must do a child safety self-check:
- Do one for each product, service and feature.
- Finish by 31 December 2026.
- Miss it, and the ministry can label it high risk straight away.
- High risk products face stricter rules.

KR-PIPA-AI-DATA-REUSE-2027.title: Reusing personal data to build AI
KR-PIPA-AI-DATA-REUSE-2027.summary:
From 9 March 2027, data collected lawfully for another purpose can build AI if:
- Anonymous or masked data would make it hard.
- It serves a public interest or similar aim.
- All legal rules are met.
- Korea's privacy regulator reviews and approves it.
First, assess risks to the people in the data.
Training AI on Korean user data? Plan this early.

APPLE-ODR-UPLOAD-BLOCK-2027.title: No new On-Demand Resources uploads
APPLE-ODR-UPLOAD-BLOCK-2027.summary:
From early 2027, Apple will reject uploads with On-Demand Resources from:
- New apps.
- Apps that have never used them.
Apps already using them aren't named. Apple suggests Background Assets. Move early.
1 January 2027 is just the earliest possible date, not Apple's.
After it, this shows as passed. Check the real date then. This gets replaced once Apple names one.

APPLE-MIN-DEPLOYMENT-TARGET-IOS13.title: Uploads must target iOS 13 or later
APPLE-MIN-DEPLOYMENT-TARGET-IOS13.summary: This covers iPhone and iPad apps you upload to App Store Connect. Each upload must target iOS 13 or later. This already applies. The check before you submit flags a lower target (IPHONEOS_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET or Podfile platform).

The review notes include a working demo account that logs in today.
- The account connects to your live server.

Your privacy answers match what your app really collects while it runs.

- Google calls this the Data Safety form.
- Include what each piece of add-on code (SDK) collects.

Your app opens and runs without crashing on a real device.
- Test on the oldest system version you support.
- Test on the newest system version too.

Your build has no placeholder content anywhere.
- No fake filler text (lorem ipsum).
- No dummy images.
- No temporary content.

3379ab2d.text:
Every link, button and path through your app works.
- No dead ends.
- No broken web links.

ad018b2a.text: Your live server is up and reachable for the whole review time.

d8c1c934.text:
Reviewers can try every feature that needs a login.
- Give them a working demo account.
- Or include a demo mode.

8aec4abb.text:
Every in app purchase works in the review build.
- Each one is live and visible.
- Each one completes a real payment.

a8af98d0.text:
Your privacy policy is published and correct.
- People can open it from inside your app.

cbadd44a.text: Your app asks for consent before it collects any data.

d93146ec.text:
Every permission request gives a specific reason.
- The reason names the real feature that uses it.

de8feace.text: If people can create an account, they can delete it in your app.

e3ffda7a.text: Users can take back consent, and features that aren't core still work.

dd5fcc66.text:
You know every piece of outside add-on code and what data it uses.
- Each one is declared in your privacy notices.

4c84bc81.text:
Private data, like login sessions, passwords and keys, is stored safely.
- On iPhone, keep it in the Keychain.
- On Android, use EncryptedSharedPreferences or the Keystore.
- Never use plain files or unprotected databases.
- Never use Android's ordinary settings storage (plain SharedPreferences).

e64e5f5e.text:
Face or fingerprint login unlocks a locked key.
- It doesn't just return a yes or no answer.
- A yes or no answer is easy to fake.
- This covers Face ID, Touch ID and Android (BiometricPrompt).

3fe44e56.text:
Your app checks if the phone is hacked, jailbroken or rooted.
- Jailbroken iPhones and rooted Android phones have safety locks removed.
- Your app runs this check on the phone itself.
- On Android, Google's phone check also backs it up (Play Integrity).
- On such phones, your app blocks or gently limits features.

47b69fcc.text:
Your app never sends data without encryption.
- Unencrypted traffic is turned off completely.
- Important servers are checked against a saved key fingerprint (SPKI pinning).
- Spare fingerprints are set up as valid backups.

de2f51e3.text:
Private files are left out of automatic phone backups.
- This covers databases and saved login data.
- On iPhone, they're left out of iCloud and iTunes backups.
- On Android, they're left out of ADB and Google Drive backups.

da4b988d.text:
Your app treats data from links that open it as unsafe.
- It cleans and fully checks that data before using it.
- It uses verified links (iOS Universal Links, Android App Links).
- It avoids homemade link formats, which other apps can take over.

dd9c5b4d.text:
Login uses a modern standard with no secret codes built into the app.
- Use a standard login method (OAuth 2.1 or OIDC with PKCE).
- Its one-time proof stops a stolen login code being reused.
- Users are logged out after a set time.
- On logout or timeout, saved logins, databases and temporary files are wiped.

b166c49b.text: Your app's name, description and screenshots match what it really does.

a5563f6e.text:
Screenshots show your app in use.
- Not the opening screen or the login screen.

c745c1b3.text:
Store page images follow Apple's rules (Apple 2.3.14, 16 October 2026).
- This covers the page header and search result images.
- They show your app or its brand.
- They suit all ages.
- They show no prices or discounts.
- They make no claims that can't be checked.
- They don't mention other apps.

55bf9331.text: Your name, subtitle and description aren't stuffed with search words.

2050062a.text: The age or content rating questions are answered honestly.

e05f7b3c.text: Nothing mentions the other phone platform or other app stores.

c181481a.text: Digital items are sold through the official store payment system.

2245ec0c.text:
Subscription details are shown before people buy.
- The terms.
- How renewal works.
- What they'll be charged.
- How to cancel.

0f6fb17c.text: Loot boxes and random rewards show the odds before people buy.

e843020f.text:
Your notes for Apple's reviewer (Notes for Review) explain what's not obvious.
- Every feature that isn't obvious.
- Every purchase inside your app.

412eafcc.text:
Your app has no hidden or secret features (Apple 2.5.19).
- No features that sleep until switched on later.
- No features you haven't told Apple about.
- No remote switch turning on things App Review didn't see.
- Apple calls this bait-and-switch.
- This check is dated 16 October 2026.

69c43a5c.text:
Your privacy labels (privacy nutrition labels) match the data your app really collects.
- Include data your add-on code collects too.

000ed7d6.text: Your app shows Apple's tracking prompt (App Tracking Transparency) before tracking across apps.

4e09dfb9.text:
Logins through other companies' social accounts come with an equally private option.
- Sign in with Apple is one example.

be681c5d.text:
Your app uses only allowed, current Apple tools.
- No Apple features meant only for Apple (private APIs).
- No old Apple code libraries that Apple has retired.
- It supports Apple's current system versions.

5153d531.text:
Your app doesn't download code that changes its features.

7251f70e.text: The background tasks you list (background modes) match what your app really does.

ea2942da.text:
You've answered Apple's new age rating questions for every app.

582a5f87.text: Any AI feature that can make sensitive content has an age limit.

b751098a.text:
Before sharing personal data with an outside AI, your app asks permission.

77cf88ed.text:
Apps in categories with special legal rules meet two extra checks.

af5e408e.text: Your app name is 30 characters or fewer.

1e915849.text:
Your contact phone for Apple's reviewers uses international format.

39d8733b.text:
Your first purchase of each type is submitted with a new app version.
- First item that gets used up (consumable).
- First item bought once and kept.
- First subscription that renews by itself.
- First subscription that doesn't renew.

d20c2639.text:
Your screenshots cover every required device.
- At least one for iPhone with Dynamic Island (medium display).
- At least one iPad 13 inch, if your app runs on iPad.

05007d2e.text:
Your app is ready for iPhone Duo (ships 23 October 2026).

6cd7dfb2.text:
iPhone Duo screenshots are uploaded in App Store Connect.

47110dab.text:
Your layout fits every iPhone Duo screen shape.
- Base it on size classes and the window's size (scene bounds).
- Never base it on device type or screen rotation.
- Never base it on fixed screen sizes.
- Keep custom views away from the cameras and the fold.

a067113a.text:
Your app's bars on iPhone Duo come from Apple's built-in system.

0e0cd70a.text:
Your app is built with at least Apple's required toolkit version (SDK).
- Today, that means the 26 toolkits.
- From April 2027, it means the 27 toolkits.

d6c138c9.text:
Your Data Safety form matches what your app really does with data.
- Count what your app does with data while it runs.
- Include data handled by every add-on code package.

7f1a867e.text:
Every sensitive permission supports a main feature that qualifies.
- Each one also has its required declaration filled in.

85d7d8ec.text:

- Access to all files.
- SMS text messages.

6629c11a.text:
If your personal developer account is new, your closed test is done.

be8b6a3e.text: Digital items sold inside your app use Google Play's payment system (Play Billing).

fafdbe33.text: Your age rating questionnaire (IARC) is complete.

50da782e.text: Your store page promises nothing your app can't do.

c3a232ce.text:
If your app is for children, it follows Google's Families rules.
- Use only ad add-on code that Google certifies for Families.

19fdeba6.text:
Your EU trader status (DSA) is declared and verified in App Store Connect.
- Apple has enforced this since 17 February 2025.
- Without it, your app is removed from the EU App Store.

89b11947.text:
Any AI feature for EU users says it's AI (from 2 August 2026).
- Show a notice inside the app.
- It says the user is interacting with AI.
- It shows at or before their first use.
- This covers every AI feature, not only chat.

0843facb.text:
AI-made audio, images, video and text are marked as AI-made.
- People can see the marking.
- Computers can also read it.

a7c934c9.text:
You keep a short record of your team's AI skills (since 2 February 2025).
- It covers everyone who builds or runs the AI feature.

3a88b18b.text:
Your app uses no AI that EU law bans (since 2 February 2025).
- No AI that manipulates people.
- No banned guessing of people's emotions.
- No sorting people into groups using their body data.

a68f9536.text:
Users agree before personal data goes to an outside AI (5.1.2(i), 13 November 2025).
- Show a pop-up that asks them first.
- Name the AI company.
- Name the kinds of data you send.
- Show it before any data leaves the phone.

e6df3907.text:
Your app is accessible and says so (European Accessibility Act).
- It meets EN 301 549 and WCAG 2.1 AA.
- It covers VoiceOver labels, Dynamic Type, contrast and Reduce Motion.
- You publish the accessibility info the law requires.
- Put it in your terms or a similar document.
- This applies from 28 June 2025.

949daf0c.text:
EU outside payments or offers, if you have them, are set up right.
- You declared Apple's permission for them.
- Apple's notice sheet is set up.
- In-App Purchase, if offered, shows at the same time.
- It's at least as easy to see.
- Options stay 12 months, and monthly reports are set up.
- These terms apply from 1 October 2026.

69716f68.text:
Children are protected on EU alternative payments.
- Under-age means under 13, or a higher consent age where set.
- Kids category apps and under-age users: other payments need a parent check.
- Kids category apps never offer purchases on a website.
- Under-age users see no offers outside the app.
- Older minors need a parent check for both.

d4a01175.text:
Data from kids under 13 follows COPPA (main deadline 22 April 2026).
- Applies if your app is for kids or collects their data.
- You get proven consent from a parent.
- Parents opt in separately to ads or sharing with others.
- You have a written policy on how long you keep data.
- You have a written plan for keeping data safe.

6945a861.text:
Your app checks user age through the store in Utah, Texas, Louisiana and Alabama.
- It asks the store for an age group.
- It confirms parent consent for a minor.
- It asks again after a major change.
- Use Apple's Declared Age Range or Google's Play Age Signals tool.
- On Android, never use age data for ads, marketing, profiling or analytics.

6dcde7b1.text:
Your age rating is 4+, 9+, 13+, 16+ or 18+, never Unrated.
- You answered the age rating questions again (by 31 January 2026).

15311108.text:
In the US store, your app links to outside websites under these terms.
- You don't need permission from Apple.
- You don't need Apple's notice screen.
- Your app has no other way to pay inside the app.
- Whether Apple can charge a fee is treated as not yet decided.

c8efa222.text:
Your app meets California and other US state privacy rules.
- It has a privacy policy and a notice when collecting data.
- Users can see, delete and correct their data.
- Users can opt out with "Do Not Sell or Share".
- Users can choose "Limit Use of Sensitive PI".
- It respects the browser privacy signal (Global Privacy Control).

906d4716.text:
Users agree in writing before your app captures their body data (biometrics).
- You publish how long you keep it and when you destroy it.
- You never sell it.
- This follows Illinois BIPA and Texas CUBI.

291c80b3.text:
Your health app follows the right US health data rule.
- First check if HIPAA applies. If it does, follow it.
- If not, follow the FTC Health Breach Notification Rule.
- That rule sets a 60 day deadline for breach notices.

203848a9.text:
Your app handles 18-plus download limits in Brazil, Australia and Singapore.
- Apple blocks these downloads in all three from 24 February 2026.
- Google Play's age checks for Brazil's new law start 17 March 2026.
- Google's checks use its age tool (Play Age Signals API).

137a671b.text:
Your UK app protects children if they're likely to use it.
- Use strong age checks under the UK Online Safety Act.
- These are called Highly Effective Age Assurance.
- Use the safe default settings from the UK Children's Code.

0ffc7e72.text:
Your app checks ages in Australia if needed.
- This applies to age restricted social media apps.
- The check finds users under 16.

b9cabc35.text:
Your app uses a Korea only version if it offers other payment options.
- That version must use an approved payment provider.

48a3ad79.text:
Your app is ready for China's rules.
- File the app with China's tech ministry (MIIT).
- Use a company based in China for this.
- Follow China's privacy law, called PIPL.
- Games also need a game license, called Banhao.

94e43c76.text:
Your Mac app shared outside the Mac App Store is set up correctly.
- Sign it with your Apple Developer ID.
- Turn on Apple's extra safety settings (hardened runtime).
- Send it to Apple for a safety check with notarytool.
- Attach Apple's approval to the app with stapler.

b0e61bf7.text:
Your app does real work of its own (Guidelines 4.2 and 4.3).
- It's not just a website wrapped as an app.
- It's not a copy, clone or duplicate of another app.
- It stands out in a crowded app category.
- Apple made the copy rule stricter in June 2026.

79d6b672.text:
Your reader app meets every guideline 3.1.3(a) condition and link rule.
- This applies when it uses Apple's External Link Account permission.
- It offers no in-app purchases while it uses that permission.

e1f0e6f5.text:
Your France encryption notice is uploaded in App Store Connect.
- It's for France's security agency (ANSSI).
- You need it if your app uses encryption that isn't exempt.
- And if your app is on the French App Store.

49a5000e.text:
You've answered the content rights question in App Store Connect.
- Keep proof you may use any content from others.

e89eb12d.text:
Your Apple Vision, Watch and TV apps meet Apple's new rules.
- visionOS apps declare their App Motion setting.
- watchOS and tvOS apps are built with Xcode 26.
- They also use the version 26 build tools (SDK).
- The build rule deadline is 28 April 2026.

46a9fa4a.text:
Your fixed-odds betting app for Brazil is ready for Apple's checks.
- These rules apply since 8 May 2026.
- Add a valid license from Brazil's Secretariat of Prizes and Bets (SPA).
- Put it in the App Review Information section.
- Set the Brazil age rating to A18 in the questionnaire.
- Send it as a new app version so Apple can verify it.

3d47b22d.text:
Your developer identity is verified with Google if your app reaches certain countries.
- This applies to Brazil, Indonesia, Singapore and Thailand.
- It's required since 30 September 2026.
- Every app ID (package name) is registered in Play Console.

731961f9.text:
Every visible task your app keeps running is declared in two places.
- In the app's setup file, set its type (foregroundServiceType).
- Add the matching permission there too.
- In Play Console, declare each type.
- Add a demo video for each type.

4ad479ec.text:
Your app uses Google's current genuine app check, not the old one.
- Use Google's app check (Play Integrity API), not SafetyNet.
- Your server checks each result.

dba75462.text:
Your app uses Google's payment add-on code, version 8 or later.
- Required for new apps and updates since 31 August 2026.
- An extension is available until 1 November 2026.
- The add-on code is Google's (Play Billing Library).
- All digital goods are sold through Google Play billing.

1764de00.text:
Your app targets a new enough Android version (targetSdkVersion).
- Most apps: 36 or higher.
- Wear OS and Android Automotive OS: 35 or higher.
- Android TV and Android XR: 34 or higher.
- Required for new apps and updates since 31 August 2026.
- An extension is available until 1 November 2026.

c825eb4e.text:
Full-screen ads never pop up by surprise at launch or mid-task.
- Every full-screen ad can be closed by 15 seconds.

35943382.text:
Your health app has everything Google asks for.
- The Health Apps Declaration is filled in.
- Each Health Connect permission is justified by a main feature.
- Your account has been moved to an organization account.
- The app shows the correct medical device label or notice.

24acf804.text:
Real money games meet the rules in each supported country.
- Required licenses or self declarations are in place.
- Location limits are in place.
- Players must pass an age check.
- Any Google age tool terms (Play Age Signals API) are met.

ea3bbbbf.text:
Your app for US users with user posts can report child abuse.
- A written plan sends reports to NCMEC's CyberTipline.
- You report once you actually know about it.
- You have a policy to keep the material for 1 year.

dc7e392c.text:
Your app with user posts or social features has safety tools (Apple 1.2).
- A content filter.
- Users can report and block others inside the app.
- Your contact details are published.
- You remove reported content and its poster within 24 hours.
- Social and Dating apps meet Google Play's Child Safety Standards.

95961f72.text:
If your app makes accounts, users can delete them and their data.
- They can do it inside the app.
- They can also do it from a public web link.
- You've declared both to the stores.

68bb5b00.text:
You aren't sanctioned, and your app skips places under trade bans.
- You're not on the US sanctions list (OFAC SDN list).
- Your store availability leaves out every place under a trade ban.

49a7d90f.text:
If you release in Syria, you've written down your US export rule details.
- Which US export rules cover your app (EAR).
- How your app is classified under them.
- The license or license exception you rely on.

984ca17c.text:
Card payments for real goods outside the store are set up safely.
- In the EU or UK, add extra payment checks (PSD2 SCA, 3D Secure).
- No card number is stored anywhere, including your servers.
- You know which card industry self-check form fits your setup.

824f4611.text:
Your Apple Developer Program membership shows Active, not Pending.
- Joining and ID checks are taking two to six weeks.
- The ID upload link has failed for some accounts.
- Developer Support takes days to reply.
- So join six weeks before your first submission.

0ddcf583.text:
The main account owner (Account Holder) accepted every Apple agreement update and attachment.
- Attachment 12, for Brazil, was due 6 July 2026.
- Attachment 14, for the EU, was due before 1 October 2026.

5bde0051.text:
Any move from a personal to a company developer account started three months ahead.

e18c41f0.text:
The social media question is answered before you upload a new version.
- Find it in App Store Connect.

0176f94e.text:
Your Google Play account type fits your app (30 September 2026).
- Money, health, VPN and government apps need an Organization account.
- That account needs a D-U-N-S number.

52dc49ba.text:
Every Play app you ship is registered for developer verification (30 September 2026).
- Register each app's package name for Android developer verification.

dfcb6304.text:
Your Play content rating form is filled in and up to date.

906ef26e.text:
Sales reporting is set up for 1 October 2026, if it applies to you.

d9c93f2c.title: Start with two quick checks
d9c93f2c.intro:
These two checks take about five minutes.
They stop most rejections on both stores, so do them first.

a16270a2.title: EU laws
a16270a2.intro:
Only if people in the EU can get your app.
Passing App Review doesn't make your app legal in the EU.

e69ee755.title: USA and other laws
e69ee755.intro:
Only if your app reaches the USA or other markets.
These laws apply on top of App Review.
Some dates are still in court, so recheck each one.

2a18f7b5.title: Common blockers in both stores
2a18f7b5.intro:
Check only the items that apply to your app.
These common problems block apps today, and other lists miss them.
The items below start with Apple.

000246e3.title: Developer account readiness
000246e3.intro:
Added in September 2026.
The checks above assume your developer account can submit apps. In 2026 that often isn't true. Plan for it.
